  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/karchive/src/kzip.cpp","function":"KZip::openArchive","line":479,"var":"buffer","code":"dev->read(buffer, 24);","note":"Attacker-controlled ZIP local header bytes are read from the input device into the parser's stack buffer.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"input bytes"}]},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/karchive/src/kzip.cpp","function":"KZip::openArchive","line":491,"var":"gpf","code":"int gpf = (uchar)buffer[0];","note":"The general-purpose flag is derived from attacker-controlled header bytes and can steer parsing into the data-descriptor path.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"header field"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/karchive/src/kzip.cpp","function":"KZip::openArchive","line":499,"var":"extralen","code":"const int extralen = uint(uchar(buffer[22])) | uint(uchar(buffer[23])) << 8;","note":"The local header's extra-field length is derived directly from attacker-controlled bytes.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"header field"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/karchive/src/kzip.cpp","function":"KZip::openArchive","line":521,"var":"handledextralen","code":"int handledextralen = qMin(extralen, (int)sizeof buffer);","note":"The parser limits the read size to the stack buffer length, but still treats the truncated bytes as an extra field.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"length"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/karchive/src/kzip.cpp","function":"KZip::openArchive","line":523,"var":"buffer","code":"n = dev->read(buffer, handledextralen);","note":"Only the first handledextralen bytes are initialized; if the field is shorter than the stack buffer, the remaining bytes stay uninitialized.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"read size"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/karchive/src/kzip.cpp","function":"parseExtraField","line":263,"var":"size","code":"while (size >= 4) {","note":"The parser consumes the truncated buffer as TLV records even though the caller did not guarantee full initialization of the stack array.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"data","via":"buffer length"}]},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/karchive/src/kzip.cpp","function":"parseExtraField","line":264,"var":"magic","code":"int magic = (uchar)buffer[0] | (uchar)buffer[1] << 8;","note":"The first TLV tag is read from bytes that may be uninitialized, which is the MSAN sink.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"data","via":"buffer contents"}]}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
